description: This Java source file defines the DigitalWatchFaceConfigListenerService class, a WearableListenerService that handles configuration messages for a watch face, updating the DataItem accordingly and managing GoogleApiClient connections.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceConfigListenerService
classes.description: A service class that listens for configuration messages for the digital watch face and updates the configuration DataItem accordingly.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages to update watch face configuration, establishing a GoogleApiClient connection if needed.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback invoked upon successful connection to Google Play services.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback invoked when the connection to Google Play services is suspended.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when the connection to Google Play services fails.
